# Election: election (ELEC)

The most recent election to a chamber or to the executive, with the system, term, seats by party and the date of the next one. One row per election, keyed by ELECTION_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `civic-store` (table `<root>/civic/election/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/world-economy/samples/election.jsonl`, 378 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/world-economy/samples/election.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `ELECTION_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ELECTION_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^ELEC-` | `"ELEC-ARG-LOW"` |
| `TITLE` | string | required | The country and the chamber or office. | — | `"Argentina · Chamber of Deputies (Cámara de Diputados)"` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | required | The country's name as the World Factbook gives it (Aruba). | — | `"Argentina"` |
| `CHAMBER` | string | required | The chamber or office elected (Executive, or the chamber's name). | — | `"Chamber of Deputies (Cámara de Diputados)"` |
| `DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in 85% of rows) | The election date (YYYY-MM-DD). | — | `"2023-10-22"` |
| `DATE_TEXT` | string | optional (filled in 87% of rows) | When the most recent election took place, as the Factbook publishes the date. | — | `"10/22/2023"` |
| `SYSTEM` | string | optional (filled in 87% of rows) | The electoral system, for example plurality, proportional representation or an electoral college. | — | `"proportional representation"` |
| `TERM` | string | optional (filled in 42% of rows) | The term of office, as published (for example 4 years). | seen: `5 years`, `4 years`, `6 years`, `3 years`, `8 years`, `0 years`, `2 years`, `9 years` | `"4 years"` |
| `WINNER` | string | optional (filled in 85% of rows) | The party with the most seats, or the elected head of state. | — | `"Union for the Homeland (UP)"` |
| `NEXT_ELECTION` | string | optional (filled in 84% of rows) | When the next election is expected, as published. | — | `"October 2025"` |
| `WOMEN` | string | optional (filled in 43% of rows) | The share of seats held by women, as published text (for example 42.4%). | — | `"42.4%"` |
| `SEATS_TEXT` | string | optional (filled in 43% of rows) | The chamber's seats as the CIA World Factbook publishes them. | — | `"257 (all directly elected)"` |
| `RESULTS` | array of objects | required (filled in 29% of rows) | The seats won by party at the election, one element per party: PARTY, SEATS and SHARE (% of seats); empty for an executive election or when the Factbook gives none. | — | [4 objects] |
| `RESULTS[].PARTY` | string | optional (filled in over 99% of `RESULTS[]` entries) | A party or group. | — | `"Union for the Homeland (UP)"` |
| `RESULTS[].SEATS` | integer | required | The seats it won. | — | `48` |
| `RESULTS[].SHARE` | number | required | Its seats as a share of the seats listed. | unit: % of seats | `37.5` |
| `SUMMARY` | object | required | The election in brief, one object from the World Factbook: SELECTION (how the body is chosen), HELD_ON, NEXT_ELECTION, CHAMBER, ELECTORAL_SYSTEM, SEATS, TERM, WOMEN and RESULTS (all as published text). | — | {…} |
| `SUMMARY.CHAMBER` | string | optional (filled in 43% of `SUMMARY` entries) | The legislative chamber elected, as the Factbook names it (Chamber of Deputies (Cámara de Diputados)), or Executive. | — | `"Chamber of Deputies (Cámara de Diputados)"` |

| `SUMMARY.ELECTORAL_SYSTEM` | string | optional (filled in 30% of `SUMMARY` entries) | How votes become seats. | one of `mixed system`, `other systems`, `plurality/majority`, `proportional representation` | `"proportional representation"` |
| `SUMMARY.TERM` | string | optional (filled in 42% of `SUMMARY` entries) | How long members serve. | seen: `5 years`, `4 years`, `6 years`, `3 years`, `8 years`, `0 years`, `2 years`, `9 years` | `"4 years"` |

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `ELECTION_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `ELECTION_ID`, `TITLE`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `CHAMBER`, `RESULTS`, `SUMMARY`, `JURISDICTION`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `ELECTION_ID` per snapshot.
- `ELECTION_ID` matches `^ELEC-`.
